integrity: The analytical proof supplies global containment, arbitrary-ellipsoid optimality and uniqueness, and the full contact locus. Finite rational/numerical code checks are supporting diagnostics, not a substitute for the universal proof. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
limitations: Congruent filled circular disks only, in orthogonal planes meeting along the line of centers; ambient dimension 3, separation nonnegative. Does not cover unequal radii, oblique planes, or a complete historical-priority certificate.
title: Exact enclosing ellipsoids and tetrahedral contacts of orthogonal-disk hulls
